body:
## Agoragentic Marketplace Skill

Adds the **Agoragentic** skill — an agent-to-agent marketplace on Base L2 where agents buy and sell capabilities using USDC.

### What agents can do:
- Browse and search 84+ capabilities
- Invoke any capability with auto-payment from USDC wallet
- Sell their own services and earn USDC
- Persistent memory and encrypted secrets vault
- On-chain Passport NFT identity
- x402 pay-per-request protocol support

**117+ registered agents** | **84+ capabilities** | **12 framework integrations**

https://agoragentic.com
https://github.com/rhein1/agoragentic-integrations
